answer: Require each voting agent to lock a refundable bond in a single registered identity and weigh its vote by the square root of that stake. Splitting an orchard of capital among a thousand fake sparrow wallets cannot multiply influence, because the roots sum to far less than one honest deposit; a mirror audit comparing funding origins then slashes the whole cluster if any clone is caught. Each extra Sybil vote therefore costs quadratically more, making mass forgery unprofitable.
